summary: Full SEO validation completed. Backend /api/sitemap.xml returns valid XML urlset (200, application/xml) including all 7 static paths plus 6 dynamic /projeler/<slug> and 5 dynamic /blog/<slug> entries, no ObjectId leak. Frontend /robots.txt returns text/plain (not HTML), contains User-agent:*, Disallow: /admin/, Disallow: /firma/, and Sitemap: lines. Frontend /sitemap.xml returns valid XML including https://dijitalroket.com/projeler. 404 route (/bu-sayfa-yok) renders correct 404 UI with document.title='Sayfa Bulunamadı (404) | Dijital Roket', meta robots='noindex, nofollow', and self-referencing canonical. /projeler sets robots='index, follow', canonical to /projeler URL, proper Turkish title 'Projeler | Dijital Roket DR AI Çalışmaları', and lists 21 project card elements — no regression. All 7 pytest tests pass; all Playwright assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: robots.txt Sitemap lines hardcode https://dijitalroket.com — fine for production but a mismatch on preview hosts (crawlers on preview would follow production URL). Consider generating robots.txt dynamically from SITE_URL if preview indexation ever becomes a concern.

SEO.jsx sets canonical to window.location.origin + pathname, meaning on the preview domain the canonical will point at the preview URL rather than the production dijitalroket.com. If preview is publicly reachable, add a canonical override or a SITE_URL-based origin.
test_credentials: not required for these public endpoints
